statement: For every field k, every integer n >= 6, and every integer r >= 0, with Delta_{n,r} defined exactly as in problem.md, k[Delta_{n,r}] is Cohen--Macaulay if and only if r >= floor((n-4)/2) and r != n-4. Thus the frozen original classification in source.md is true, with no characteristic-dependent branch.
contribution: A complete elementary resolution via an exact classification of every facet dimension of the interval-gap complex. Nonpurity handles all low-range parameters except the uniquely pure family n=3r+7; that family is excluded over every field by an explicit integral 1-cocycle and 4-cycle pairing equal to -1. The positive one-dimensional range is proved pure and connected, the excluded r=n-4 case is a disconnected perfect matching, and r>=n-3 is nonempty and zero-dimensional.
